mentions.name: Navonic
mentions.description: Navonic is a wearable device for athletes, especially cyclists, and their coaches. The team has completed extensive user testing and is moving from prototyping to design-for-manufacturing and testing/validation ahead of shipping.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Navonic (https://www.navonic.co), a wearable for athletes (especially cyclists) and coaches. We've done lots of user testing and are moving from prototyping to DFM and testing/validation, and hopefully shipping soon.
